finding: Two identical submissions settle twice. There is no idempotency contract, so a retry or two browser monitors can create another trade. This is a missing replay safeguard; intentional repeat orders must still be allowed with different intent IDs.

finding: Trading pause blocks a sell that reduces an existing holding. Browser bracket exits submit the same sell path, so protection can be disabled by the pause intended to reduce risk.
status: open until desired-behavior evidence and phase gate review

finding: A fresh buy fills after a realised loss of 50 with `daily_loss_limit=1`. That setting is stored and advertised as a guardrail but not enforced by local execution.
status: open until desired-behavior evidence and phase gate review

finding: A DAY order created October 1 remains fillable October 14. No session expiry or expiration state is implemented.
status: open until desired-behavior evidence and phase gate review

finding: The server accepts an open quote one day in the future and a closed-session quote from 2020. Client validation has a future-time check, but the authority boundary does not; closed quotes have no maximum age.
status: open until desired-behavior evidence and phase gate review

finding: The Orders page reconstructs positions from only the newest 60 orders. Older buys can disappear while later sells remain. Its average is all historical buys divided by buy quantity, rather than the remaining holding's cost basis after sales/rebuys.
status: open until desired-behavior evidence and phase gate review

finding: Alerts/brackets run in a browser interval. Peaks and completed exits live in browser storage; closing the tab stops monitoring. Multiple tabs share account state without a server claim/lease. Protection is not a durable server capability.
status: open until desired-behavior evidence and phase gate review

finding: Charges are estimated with one constant and are not debited. Orders store the fill price but not the complete quote/provenance snapshot. Position limits use cost basis, not current marked equity. No spread, liquidity, partial-fill, or settlement model exists.
status: open until desired-behavior evidence and phase gate review

finding: Basket legs execute sequentially and may partially succeed. Unknown prices contribute zero to the estimate. Client eligibility is different from the shared quote validator; retrying the entire basket can duplicate successful legs.
status: open until desired-behavior evidence and phase gate review

finding: `trade_journal` accepts `risks:null`. The review UI reads `risks.length` and `risks.join`, producing a runtime type error. Generic local mutations lack table-specific schemas.
status: open until desired-behavior evidence and phase gate review

finding: Negative daily-loss and confirmation thresholds are accepted and persisted. Validating two positive fields does not validate the whole risk policy.
status: open until desired-behavior evidence and phase gate review

finding: Every operation reads/parses the whole JSON file; mutations synchronously replace the whole file.
